title: WOWW: Add string values to zones/areas and maps, along with internal upgrades
description:
Adds more to https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/17481.

This PR:
* Changes "zones" to "areas". This is label is more correct since there are only about 50 zones in Vanilla WoW, but over a thousand smaller areas within those zones. The field in the message uses areas.
* Adds string values for zones and maps.
* Fixes incorrect values in the class enum. The real values skip random integer values for some reason.
* Add fields for all the "movement" messages. This is a large block of messages that share the same layout.
* Refactor the remaining logic to use a `ptvcursor_t` instead. This significantly reduces the boilerplate required.

Note that some of the areas and maps have weird developer names, like the ones prefixed with `UNUSED` and the such, despite not being unused.
